item.text:
The module calculates order totals, applies discount codes, computes an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bug: `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws when reading `.price`. Change it to `i < items.length`. This breaks `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` too.

Potential logic bug: `averageItemPrice` divides the extended order total (`price × qty`) by the number of lines, not total item quantity. If it means per-unit price, it should divide by summed quantities; empty orders also need explicit handling.
